contentHtml:
Blizzard has revealed the Bonus Reward for completing the October 2026 Traveler's Log!

In today's WoW Weekly, Blizzard recapped the last week of World of Warcraft, while also revealing something new for the future. The October 2026 Trading Post's bonus reward is Ensemble: Thornshadow Assassin's Attire!

 
Blizzard
View Original

Dress to Distress with Costumed Calamity in October’s Trading Post

This Month's Bonus Reward: Thornshadow Assassin's Attire Transmog Set
“For missions that don't officially exist.”
October’s Trading Post is cloaked in calamity, with fiendish finds ready to add chaos to your collection. Complete activities to earn Trader’s Tender, fill your Traveler’s Log, and slink into the shadows with the Ensemble: Thornshadow Assassin's Attire.

Visit T&W (Tawney and Wilder) just outside the Mage District in Stormwind, or the Zen’shiri Trading Post next to Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar, to check out the latest items they have available. Players can also visit the Trading Post in the capital cities of Dornogal (The Foregrounds) on the Isle of Dorn and in the renewed Silvermoon City, where representatives of both Tawney and Wilder and the Zen’shiri Trading Post are open for business.

Champions new to or returning to World of Warcraft and Midnight can tour the Trading Post to learn everything you need to know, from where to find it to how you can earn additional Trader's Tender through the Traveler's Log.

The September Trading Post Outlet closes soon! Get in your last purchases before the vendors change over to their October inventory.

contentHtml:
Blizzard has posted this week's WoW Weekly which includes the first episode of the WoW: Forever Podcast, Brewfest and more!
Blizzard
View Original
There’s more to discover in World of Warcraft: Forever. This week, dig into our latest articles covering your first choices in a reimagined original Azeroth—from choosing your ruleset and naming your character to exploring class and race combinations, the new Skyborne race, and the Legacy System—then watch episode 1 of the World of Warcraft: Forever Podcast. You can also look ahead to October’s Trading Post and catch up on the Brewfest in-game holiday, what’s happening in the WoW Portal Room, and more in WoW Weekly.

Watch the World of Warcraft: Forever Podcast, Ep. 1

Join Senior Game Designer Josh “Aggrend” Greenfield, Lead Classic Designer Tim Jones, and content creators Countdown To Classic and Xaryu in the first episode of the World of Warcraft: Forever Podcast.

Get to Know World of Warcraft: Forever

Catch up on the latest from World of Warcraft: Forever, including choosing your ruleset, naming your character, class and race combinations, the Skyborne, and the Legacy System as you prepare to carve your path through Azeroth.
Choose Your Ruleset
Every journey through Azeroth begins with a choice about the kind of world you want to step into. In World of Warcraft: Forever, rulesets help you choose the kind of experience you want first as you begin carving your path through Azeroth. All you need to know is in our overview.
Create a Name of Your Own
A name is one of the first choices you make when creating a character. In World of Warcraft: Forever, character names gain more room to breathe through a new two-name structure designed for a larger, realmless Azeroth. More details can be found here.
Create the Hero You Want to Be
Race and class shape the hero you become, from the fantasy you embody to the role you take on in the world. You can return to a familiar favorite, explore a newly available combination, or begin your journey as a Skyborne character, with each choice offering a different way to step into Azeroth’s next chapter. Your hero awaits—learn more about it in our article.
Meet the New Skyborne
A new adventure rises above Azeroth. The Skyborne invite you into a story of wind and ancestry—one that begins on Zephras Isle and continues as you decide whether your Skyborne will join the Horde or the Alliance. Learn more about the Skyborne here.
Get to Know the Legacy System
Take a peek at an account-wide horizontal progression system—the Legacy System. It’s a way to progress by exploring more of what the game has to offer, while every character you love contributes to your journey. Learn more about this feature here.

Raise Your Stein! Brewfest Returns with Battle-Brewed Rewards

Eat delicious food, drink bountiful beverages, and ride rams around barrels of apples! Brewfest has arrived, and you can enjoy all that and more!

When : September 20–October 6
Where : Silvermoon City, Valdrakken, Dornogal, Valdrakken, Ironforge, and Orgrimmar
Currency : Brewfest Prize Tokens—used to purchase most items at the Brewfest vendor.

Strike up a conversation with the Holiday Enthusiast in Silvermoon City to begin the brewfestivities. In addition to the usual fun in Ironforge and Orgrimmar, you can complete new Brewfest quests throughout Quel’Thalas, and the Brewfest Banquet Outdoor Scenario will keep you hopping.

What's Brewfest without some stout rewards? Head over to our article to see what's freshly tapped for Midnight.

World of Warcraft®: Forever Escape Together Comes to Toronto

Heroes of Azeroth, the Horde and the Alliance are putting their rivalry to the ultimate test—and you're invited to tune in and join the excitement.

Watch the action unfold live as real-world champions of the Horde and the Alliance battle it out in a series of head-to-head challenges before facing their final test together—an Escape Room inspired by the iconic Scarlet Monastery.

Or, if you're in the Toronto area, bring friends and assemble your dungeon party to see if you can outwit the Scarlet Monastery-inspired escape room before time runs out.

Don't miss the chance to relive the adventure. Whether you're enjoying it from home or escaping into it in person, it’s time to answer the call.
Click to Learn More

Latest News from the WoW Portal Room

WoW Portal Room welcomes the World of Warcraft: Forever community!

New channels and roles have been added to support Forever players, and our Forever Collection code giveaway starts today. There’s so much more to come, so join us and stay tuned.
Find Your People
A team of WoW Ambassadors representing partnered community Discord servers is ready to meet you and help you with finding a space that fits your needs. Participating Discords enjoy special recognition, access to exclusive events, and direct support from Blizzard—making every server a more vibrant place to connect.

WoW Ambassadors Events

WoW Ambassador-partnered community Discord servers host and sponsor events that bring the community together to celebrate connection, creativity, and shared passion.

WoW Secret Finding & Collections Celebrates Its 10th Anniversary

Congratulations to the WoW Secret Finding & Collections Discord on its 10th anniversary!

WoW Secret Finding & Collections is the largest Discord community dedicated to solving in-game secrets, collecting mounts, pets, toys, and more. To celebrate their 10-year anniversary, they're hosting an event focused on helping others and exploring Azeroth with some juicy rewards up for grabs!
Join to Learn More
Architects of Azeroth Celebrates a Membership Milestone

Architects of Azeroth is celebrating a huge membership milestone—4,000 members! Join them for some fun Housing giveaways to help celebrate this amazing milestone!

Architects of Azeroth is one of the oldest and largest WoW Housing communities where decorators gather to plot questionable furniture decisions. Share your builds, ask questions, get help when your layout refuses to cooperate, and browse our growing collection of resources. Whether you’re placing your first chair or building a palace, you’ll fit right in.
Join to Learn More
Let us journey alongside you, regale you with tales of adventure in faraway places, map out roads less traveled, and direct your gaze toward the legendary challenges that await. Return each week to the World of Warcraft news site, where we'll uncover your destiny together.

contentHtml:
Blizzard has announced a WoW: Forever escape room in Toronto, so if you're in the area, you can escape the Scarlet Monastery in person!

There will be an accompanying head-to-head escape room challenge on Twitch and YouTube, but we don't know who will be racing to escape the Monastery just yet. We'll have to wait and see!
Blizzard

Heroes of Azeroth, the Horde and the Alliance are putting their rivalry to the ultimate test—and you're invited to tune in and join the excitement.

The Showdown: Two Teams, One Escape Room

Brace yourself for an epic experience as WoW®: Forever presents Escape Together comes to Toronto, where thrills await!

When: Friday, October 23
Where: Official Warcraft Twitch and YouTube Channels

Watch the action unfold live as real-world champions of the Horde and the Alliance battle it out in a series of head-to-head challenges before facing their final test together—an Escape Room inspired by the iconic Scarlet Monastery, where many early adventurers tested their mettle against the Scarlet Crusade’s large garrison of fanatics.

We'll reveal our stream time and competitors soon, so stay tuned to find out who's been selected and which faction will outthink, outmaneuver, and out-escape the other.

Escape the Scarlet Monastery in Person in Toronto

Do you and your closest allies have what it takes to defeat the Scarlet Monastery escape room on your own? Prove your skills and experience the challenge firsthand.

If you're in the Toronto area, bring friends and assemble your dungeon party to see if you can outwit the Scarlet Monastery-inspired escape room before time runs out.

When: October 8–11
Where: Escape Manor, King Street, Toronto, Ontario

Get Your Tickets

Don't miss the chance to relive the adventure. Whether you're enjoying it from home or escaping into it in person, it’s time to answer the call.

title.en: NetEase Cracking Down on Paid Addons in WoW China
title.es: NetEase toma medidas enérgicas contra los complementos de pago en WoW China

summary.en: NetEase Cracking Down on Paid Addons in WoW China...
summary.es: NetEase tomando medidas enérgicas contra los complementos de pago en WoW China...

contentHtml:
According to CN Community Contributor Elspeth, NetEase is cracking down on paid WoW Addons, possibly even leading to legal action.

Paid addons have been a very controversial topic in the WoW community, with many players feeling that the enforcement of paid addons is severely lacking in the West. The rules of the UI Addon-On Development Policy can be found here and state many rules, including addons being free of charge, addons not soliciting donations in-game, and more.

Blizzard expands the "free of charge" rule with the following:
View Original
World of Warcraft User Interface Add-On Development Policy

1) Add-ons must be free of charge.
All add-ons must be distributed free of charge. Developers may not create “premium” versions of add-ons with additional for-pay features, charge money to download an add-on, charge for services related to the add-on, or otherwise require some form of monetary compensation to download or access an add-on.
This is controversial in the community, as there are addons out there that seem to violate it. Some addons seem to enter a grey area where they give away the base version for free, but then sell a premium upcharge for the pre-built data. In addition, some streamers and content creators have sold UI packs, customizations of addons, to their subscriptions, which also falls into a grey area.

According to Elspeth on X (Twitter), China is cracking down on paid and monetized addons for CN realms. They note that addons must be free with no paid unlocks, VIP tiers, subscriptions, etc., but also note "no paid WA/config sharing", which seems to imply that addon/streamer packs and free addons with paid settings cannot be monetized either.

Tweet #2102948756882968655


Some of the biggest notes from this are:
  • They encourage players to support free addons and encourage a healthy addon ecosystem that promotes sharing and free access.
  • They strictly oppose any form of paid addon, including, but not limited to, paid purchases, VIP versions, and pay-per-use services.
  • They support platforms providing authors with reasonable incentives through a tipping system. Tipping should be purely voluntary and not linked to add-on functionality. Otherwise, it will be considered a paid service.
  • After this announcement, any platform or individual that continues to engage in paid addons will be subject to legal action.

title.en: 0.18% of Names Earned a Ban from WoW: Forever Beta
title.es: 0.18% de los nombres ganaron una prohibición de WoW: Forever Beta

summary.en: 0.18% of Names Earned a Ban from WoW: Forever Beta...
summary.es: 0.18% de los nombres ganaron una prohibición de WoW: Beta para siempre...

contentHtml:
Senior Game Producer, Tom Ellis, has commented on the recent bans and forced name changes from the Forever: Beta.

With the launch of yesterday's new WoW: Forever Beta build, Blizzard announced that players will be losing Beta access for violations of their Code of Conduct for their character naming conventions. Shortly after this announcement, Tom Ellis commented on the bans, noting that everyone who claims they were removed from Beta for naming a character something mundane is not telling the truth, and names like this would instead trigger a forced name change.

Tweet #2103281070569292037
Tom Ellis said:
Anyone saying they were removed from beta for naming their character “Billy Mcsuckmahballz” is telling little white lies. That character likely just received a forced name change.

Multiple unfortunate humans read through every name that was removed from beta today.

If you’re genuinely confused, remember that it’s our database, we can see every character you’ve created, not just the one you’re playing.

I read the list. No sympathy. Be a better human next time.
This morning, he noted that some of the team spent last night reviewing the entire ban list again and looking over every Reddit and Twitter post, and every one of those posts has omitted one of their inappropriate names. He ends his comment, mentioning that the naming conventions have not changed at any point in WoW, and after 20 years they assumed players would know what was okay. and 0.18% of names earned a ban from WoW: Forever Beta.

Tweet #2103470811826778368
Tom Ellis said:
Well honestly I should know better than to have waded into that swamp, that’s on me. Since we’re here now I’ll give one more update on this topic before getting back to actually working on launch instead of reading everyone’s hilarious variations of the N word.

A couple of us spent the evening reading through everything again and checked every Reddit post and twitter and so far every one of them who’s posted their three cheeky or just inappropriate names has had a 4th character they have accidentally omitted. We’ve found exactly one person who we genuinely think was going for an RP sounding name and ran head first into the sad fact we have way too many derogatory terms for some people. I’m going to have yet another poor sod read through it again too so we have yet another perspective.

What else have I seen a lot, ok yep, Blizzard is going extra woke or other crap like that. Nope, any name we revoked beta for yesterday would have not been allowed in any variation of WoW at any time in its history and would have earned you a suspension. We just manually ran names through the same system they would have been normally and then out of an abundance of caution read through every one.

No new standards have been set or enforced for Forever’s Beta.

Our naming filter wasn’t ready to rock for dual names but we naively thought after twenty years folks knew what was and wasn’t ok and we’d be fine for a few weeks of beta till it came online. Yeah.

0.18% of names earned an exit from beta. Please pick better names at launch. Everyone else, thanks for checking out our beta, have fun and keep the feedback coming.
